title: From literature review to a working experiment
body: Can five imperfect citation checkers reduce false alarms through majority voting?
detail: T23 continuity: presentation, bibliographic identity, access and claim support are separate. This study measures bibliographic alerts only.
code:
INPUT: five recorded checker flags per reference
OUTPUT: flag / accept, or defer for review
DATA: 104 references from three documents
SCOPE: recorded-decision replay + new post-processing

title: Check the data version before interpreting results
body:
Original: 33 problematic + 71 verified
Corrected: 35 problematic + 69 verified
detail: The authors corrected P3:R12 and P3:R18. All 520 tool flags match. Both raw versions, checksums and the post-freeze amendment are preserved.
code:
P3:R12: label 0 -> 1; flags (0, 0, 0, 1, 1)
P3:R18: label 0 -> 1; flags (0, 0, 1, 1, 1)

Current-label results: results/corrected/
Historical reproduction: results/

title: Trace the predictor
body: The voting function never sees the manual label.
detail: With three flags, k=3 flags the reference, k=4 accepts it, and the triage rule defers it. Missing or unknown flags cause an error.

title: Validate before comparing
body:
16 tests passed.
24 numerical output files reproduced exactly.
detail: The historical RefChecker confusion matrix matches the source paper. This validates evaluation replay; it does not rerun the original service.
code:
Historical RefChecker: TP32 FP36 TN35 FN1

python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python scripts/run_study.py
python scripts/run_study.py --corrected

Evidence: results/logs/clean_reproduction.txt

title: The primary majority hypothesis failed
body:
Majority: 36 false alarms, 4 misses
RefChecker: 34 false alarms, 1 miss
detail: Corrected labels. Majority BA = .682; RefChecker BA = .739. The frozen target required an FPR reduction of at least .10 and recall at least .80.

title: A favorable score can conceal a trade-off
body: Four votes: BA .792, but recall only .714.
detail: The complete threshold sweep is retained. No full-panel threshold meets both parts of the frozen target. The best pooled BA is not independent validation.

title: Hold an entire source document out
detail: Selection uses only the other documents. Corrected pooled BA is .704. Three documents cannot establish performance on a wider document population.

title: Report favorable ablations with their limits
body: Two four-tool panels meet the numerical criterion on this corpus.
detail: Removing a checker also raises the required vote fraction to 3/4. Selecting a favorable panel after seeing these data requires new validation; it is not the primary result.

title: Deferral is not a correct prediction
body: 53 references deferred; 9 errors in 51 automatic decisions.
detail: Ten problematic references are deferred. Automatic flags identify 25 of 35 problems overall. A conditional recall of 1.0 on the automatic subset is not overall recall.

title: Reproduce, explain, and keep the claims narrow
body: Real code. Saved outputs. Explicit limits and AI disclosure.
detail: Open the executed notebook and viva guide. This captioned walkthrough was prepared with AI; it is not a recording of the student presenting or proof of personal understanding.
code:
python scripts/environment_check.py
python scripts/run_study.py --corrected
python scripts/plot_results.py --results results/corrected
python scripts/build_paper_assets.py
